diff --git a/src/upload/uploadQueue.ts b/src/upload/uploadQueue.ts
index 73e4fba..a6045f7 100644
--- a/src/upload/uploadQueue.ts
+++ b/src/upload/uploadQueue.ts
@@ -1,6 +1,11 @@
-export const MAX_TRIES = 1
+export const MAX_TRIES = 5
 
 export async function upload(item) {
-  await send(item)
+  for (let tryNo = 1; tryNo <= MAX_TRIES; tryNo++) {
+    const result = await send(item)
+    if (!isRetryable(result)) return result
+    item.tryNo = tryNo
+    await wait(backoff(tryNo, result))
+  }
   return item
 }
